situations.title: 면회 안내·환경 설명
situations.tagline: I've never been in an ICU — what should I expect when I see her?
situations.brief: ICU 오리엔테이션으로 면회 절차와 환경을 안내해 불안을 줄이세요.
keyPhrases: Let me walk you through what you'll see at her bedside.
There will be monitors and tubes, and that's normal here.
You can talk to her and hold her hand.

situations.title: 장비·알람 설명
situations.tagline: Those machines keep beeping — is something wrong?
situations.brief: 장비와 알람의 의미를 설명해 가족의 불안을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: Most alarms are just reminders, not emergencies.
This monitor shows her heart rate and oxygen.
I'm watching all of these closely for her.
goals: 장비와 알람의 의미를 이해 가능하게 설명한다

situations.title: 일일 상태 업데이트
situations.tagline: How is he doing today compared to yesterday?
situations.brief: 이해 가능한 설명으로 환자의 일일 상태를 업데이트하세요.
keyPhrases: Today his oxygen levels are a little better.
We're slowly reducing the support he needs.
It's a small step, but it's in the right direction.
goals: 환자의 일일 경과를 이해 가능하게 전달한다

situations.title: 가족 질문 응대
situations.tagline: I have so many questions — can you help me understand what's going on?
situations.brief: 가족의 정보 요구에 성실히 응대하며 궁금증을 해소하세요.
keyPhrases: Please ask me anything — that's what I'm here for.
Let me explain that in a way that makes sense.
If I don't know, I'll find out and get back to you.
goals: 답할 수 없는 질문은 확인해 후속한다

situations.title: 면회 규칙·감염관리 안내
situations.tagline: Why do I have to wear a gown and gloves to see my own mother?
situations.brief: 참여 조건인 면회 규칙과 감염관리 절차를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The gown and gloves protect her from infection.
Please wash your hands before and after visiting.
These steps keep both of you safe.

situations.title: 가족 정서 지지 기초
situations.tagline: This is all just so overwhelming — I don't know how to cope.
situations.brief: 경청과 안심을 바탕으로 가족의 정서를 기초적으로 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: It's completely understandable to feel this way.
You don't have to go through this alone.
There are support services here whenever you need them.

situations.title: 가족 회의 준비·진행 지원
situations.tagline: We're all coming in to meet the doctor — how should we get ready?
situations.brief: 정보를 정리해 가족 회의의 준비와 진행을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's list the questions your family wants answered.
I'll make sure everyone can hear and be heard.
We'll go over his condition together, step by step.

situations.title: 목표설정 대화 참여
situations.tagline: What would he want? I think I know, but I need help sorting it out.
situations.brief: 환자의 가치를 확인하며 목표설정 대화에 참여해 가족을 돕세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me about what mattered most to him in life.
What would he say if he could speak right now?
Let's use his values to guide our decisions.

situations.title: 나쁜 소식 전달 지원
situations.tagline: The doctor is coming to talk to us — is it bad news?
situations.brief: SPIKES 틀에 따라 나쁜 소식 전달을 지원하고 가족을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's sit down together before the doctor speaks.
I'll be right here with you during the conversation.
Take your time — we can pause whenever you need.
goals: SPIKES 틀에 맞춰 나쁜 소식 전달을 지원한다

situations.title: 의사결정 대리인 확인
situations.tagline: Who's supposed to make the decisions — me or my sister?
situations.brief: surrogate 원칙에 따라 의사결정 대리인을 확인하고 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: Did he name a healthcare proxy in any documents?
If not, we follow the legal order for surrogates.
Let's clarify who speaks for him so we're aligned.
goals: 의사결정 대리인을 문서와 원칙에 따라 확인한다

situations.title: 상충하는 가족 기대 조율
situations.tagline: My aunt expects a full recovery, but I'm not so sure — how do we handle that?
situations.brief: 상충하는 가족의 기대를 조율하고 현실적 이해를 돕세요.
keyPhrases: It's normal for family members to see things differently.
Let's make sure everyone hears the same information.
I'll help the team clarify what's realistic.

situations.title: 가족 참여 돌봄
situations.tagline: Is there anything I can actually do to help take care of him?
situations.brief: family-centered 원칙으로 가족이 돌봄에 참여하도록 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You can help with mouth care and moisturizing his lips.
Talking and reading to him really does help.
Being here for him is meaningful care too.
goals: 가족이 참여할 수 있는 돌봄 활동을 안내한다

situations.title: 예후 불확실성 소통
situations.tagline: Just tell me straight — is he going to make it or not?
situations.brief: 정직과 희망의 균형을 지키며 예후 불확실성을 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I wish I could give you a certain answer.
His condition is serious, and the next days are critical.
We're hoping for the best while preparing for all outcomes.

situations.title: 소아 방문·형제 지원
situations.tagline: Should I bring his little sister to see him? I don't know if it's right.
situations.brief: 가족 단위 접근으로 소아 방문과 형제 지원을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Child life specialists can prepare her for the visit.
We'll explain things in words she can understand.
It's okay to include her if that feels right for your family.

situations.title: 원격 가족 소통
situations.tagline: His son is overseas — can we connect him by video to see his dad?
situations.brief: 화상으로 부재 가족을 연결해 원격 소통을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: We can set up a video call at the bedside.
I'll hold the tablet so his son can see and talk to him.
Let's find a time that works across the time zones.

situations.title: 임종 임박 나쁜 소식 전달
situations.tagline: You're telling me... he's not going to survive this, are you?
situations.brief: 급성 위기 소통으로 임종 임박이라는 나쁜 소식을 전달하고 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so sorry — his body is no longer responding to treatment.
We believe he is nearing the end of his life.
We'll keep him comfortable, and you can be with him.
goals: 임종 임박이라는 나쁜 소식을 정직하고 부드럽게 전한다

situations.title: 가족 급성 비탄·위기 대응
situations.tagline: No, no, this can't be happening — not him!
situations.brief: 정서 응급으로 급성 비탄에 빠진 가족을 안정시키고 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm here with you — you're not alone in this.
Take a moment; there's no need to hold it together.
Let me get you a quiet space and someone to support you.
goals: 급성 비탄 반응을 안전하게 수용하고 안정시킨다

situations.title: 목표 불일치·갈등 중재
situations.tagline: My brother and I completely disagree about what to do — I can't take this.
situations.brief: 윤리와 중재의 관점에서 가족 간 목표 불일치와 갈등을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: You both want what's best for him — that's your common ground.
Let's center this on what he would have wanted.
The ethics and palliative teams can help us move forward.
goals: 가족 간 목표 불일치를 중립적으로 중재한다
환자 중심의 공통 기반을 찾도록 이끈다

situations.title: 대리결정 부재 상황
situations.tagline: I'm just a neighbor — I don't think I should be the one deciding this.
situations.brief: 대리결정자가 불분명한 상황에서 의사결정 지원 절차를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for being here for him.
Since there's no named proxy, the team follows a set process.
We'll involve the ethics committee to decide in his best interest.
goals: 윤리위원회 등 의사결정 지원 절차를 연계한다

situations.title: 분노·불신 가족 대응
situations.tagline: You people aren't telling me everything — what are you hiding?!
situations.brief: de-escalation 기법으로 분노와 불신에 찬 가족에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear that you're angry, and you deserve straight answers.
Nothing is being hidden — let me go through everything with you.
Let's sit down and I'll answer every question you have.

situations.title: 사별·애도 지원·후속
situations.tagline: He's gone... I don't even know what I'm supposed to do now.
situations.brief: bereavement 지원으로 사별한 가족의 애도를 돕고 후속을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so deeply sorry for your loss.
Take all the time you need — there's no rush at all.
I'll give you information on next steps and grief support.
goals: 후속 절차와 애도 지원 자원을 안내한다
